desc: I am a web developer passionate about tech, with a sense of aesthetics and technical rigor in creating digital projects that combine performance and user experience.
After my first steps in web development at 17 and exploring programming basics in 2017, it was in 2021 that I seriously dove into coding through intensive and in-depth training.
Eager to stay up-to-date on web, development and design practices and techniques, I specialize in creating solutions that meet real user needs.
I am open and motivated to collaborate and participate in innovative and impactful projects in the new technologies sector.
